newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish power plant group issues PLN 40 mln CPs.
newsitem.headline: Polish power plant group issues PLN 40 mln CPs.

text.p: Poland's power plant group Zespol Elektrowni Dolna Odra has launched a 40 million zloty commercial paper programme, an official from manager Pekao SA bank said on Thursday.
Agnieszka Bruno from the capital operations department told Reuters the paper, maturing December 30 1996, carried a yield of 19 percent and had a nominal value of 500,000 zlotys.
The programme is guaranteed by Pekao SA and Merrill Lynch International.
Last month a group of banks lead by Pekao SA gave Dolna Odra a credit of 98.5 million zlotys, as part of a 170 million zloty modernisation programme. -- Robert Bogdanski +48 22 653 9700
